info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Pargasit Produce Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Pargasit Produce Detail Catalog API facilitates the enhancement of the produce catalog by allowing users to add detailed information about various Pargasit produce items. This endpoint enables the submission of comprehensive details, such as descriptions, prices, and availability, ensuring an enriched catalog for users. Typical consumers include inventory managers and agricultural businesses seeking to maintain accurate product listings. This API is crucial for streamlining the onboarding of new produce items into the catalog.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create new details for Pargasit produce. It expects the necessary attributes in the request body to successfully save the details in the database.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit detailed information about the pargasit produce. The user must provide all necessary fields as defined in the schema to ensure successful processing of the request.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the details of the requested resource.
